title: Egypt *as a stage.*
subtitle: Three settings for a CRUSH evening where art, music and a luxury brand meet, with NOYA running every element on the ground.

blocks.text: CRUSH brings brands and artists together, Cartier with Gloria Gaynor, IWC with Jamiroquai, in moments people remember. Egypt offers settings few cities can match. NOYA makes them work on the day.
One evening, built for a brand's closest clients, in a place they have never been hosted before.

blocks.label: Why now
blocks.title: A new chapter for luxury in Egypt.

rows: The Grand Egyptian Museum has opened near the Pyramids of Giza, giving Cairo a cultural landmark of global scale.
Dior presented its Men's Fall 2023 show at the Pyramids of Giza, a first for a luxury house at the site.
Luxury hospitality continues to grow across Cairo, El Gouna and the North Coast.
ICONS. by CRUSH brings the artists and cultural figures. NOYA brings the setting, the hospitality and the logistics.

items.title: Dinner facing the Pyramids
items.text: A seated dinner for a brand's top clients, set so the Pyramids are the backdrop at sunset, followed by a live performance from an artist of CRUSH's choosing.

blocks.text: Every element sits with one NOYA team: suppliers, permits, guest movements and the details guests never see. CRUSH's team stays focused on the brand, the artists and the show.
